title: Foliated and Mather-Jacobian discrepancies via tangential arcs
summary: This article develops a tangential arc-space approach to foliated discrepancies for logarithmic simple co-rank one foliations on threefolds, relative to a fixed invariant normal crossing separatrix divisor. In the non-resonant logarithmic case, reduced tangential arcs centred on the prescribed tangential locus are confined to this divisor. The tangential sector is therefore presented, at the reduced arc level, by the normalised separatrix-conductor system.
